sample.name: battlecard
sample.title: Competitive battlecard
sample.summary: A sourced battlecard on one competitor that a seller can use in a deal.
sample.description: Name your company and one competitor, and get a sourced battlecard a seller can use in a deal. It covers the competitor's positioning and target customers, public pricing and recent price changes, a capability-by-capability comparison with yes, no, partial or unclear marked per cell, strengths to respect, weaknesses backed by reviews and incidents, recent moves, win themes, objection responses and questions that expose gaps. Every claim is cited. Where it cannot verify your side or their price, it says unclear or contact sales.
